summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests danvatirsen alone and then combined with venetoclax in adults with relapsed or refractory myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) or acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Danvatirsen is given by infusion, with loading doses and then weekly doses over 28-day cycles at increasing dose levels, and venetoclax is taken by mouth at 400 mg daily for 28 days per cycle. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study is described as evaluating safety and efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba danvatirsen solo y después combinado con venetoclax en adultos con síndromes mielodisplásicos (SMD) o leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivantes o refractarios. El danvatirsen se administra por infusión, con dosis de carga y luego dosis semanales en ciclos de 28 días, a niveles de dosis crecientes, y el venetoclax se toma por vía oral a 400 mg diarios durante 28 días por ciclo. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio se describe como una evaluación de seguridad y eficacia.
who_for: Age 18 years or older and able to sign informed consent.
Morphologically confirmed AML or MDS by WHO criteria.
Relapsed or refractory AML with no FDA-approved or standard therapy options.
Intermediate, high or very high IPSS-R MDS refractory or relapsed after at least 2 cycles of hypomethylating agent therapy, or rapid progression.
not_for: Low or very low risk MDS after failure of first-line hypomethylating agents.
